title: Scattering Of Light
definition: Scattering of light is the phenomenon in which light rays are deflected from their straight path upon striking particles, molecules, or suspended droplets in a medium, depending on the relative size of the particle to the incident wavelength.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Civil Services Prelims (GS-1 Physics applications like why the sky is blue, red sunrise/sunset, Tyndall effect) and GS-3 Science & Tech applications in atmospheric optics and laser communications.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Rayleigh, Mie, and Raman scattering.
Evaluate spatial distribution of atmospheric phenomena and optical applications.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions on light phenomena.
